name: Georgia's Greek Cuisine
notes: Restaurant's own site (georgiasgreekcuisine.com) has a full first-party HTML menu with prices, but it is stamped 'Rev 10-06-2018.01' in the page footer - 8 years stale - and DoorDash reviews dated through Aug 2026 plus current DoorDash prices running noticeably higher on every overlapping dish (e.g. Gyros Plate $23->$25, Chicken Kebab $20->$22, Opa Combo $35->$37, Gyros sandwich $13->$15) confirm the site is out of date rather than DoorDash being marked up by a clean multiplier (ratios ranged 1.05-1.15, not a single clean markup factor, consistent with organic price growth over 8 years rather than a delivery fee). DoorDash's own disclaimer states 'Prices on this menu are set directly by the Merchant.' Used DoorDash's current (2026) prices instead of the stale 2018 site; dish descriptions/lineup match the site closely, confirming same restaurant/menu. Reached: Appetizers (partial), Salads and Soups (full), Sandwiches & Sides (full), Dinner Entrees (full), Kids (partial, 1 of ~3 items), Desserts (full), Beverages (full). Did not capture full Appetizers list (Feta Cheese/Olives, Spicy Feta Spread, Saganaki, Tiropita/Spanakopita, Gigantes, Calamari appetizer, Falafel appetizer, Small Greek Salad, Falafel Salad) because current DoorDash prices for those specific items were not visible during the session and are omitted rather than carried over from the stale 2018 site.
